column1: # Known-genotype sanity set for the ERG11 re-caller (scripts/recaller_sanity.py).
# Purpose: before trusting the reads->consensus->call orchestration on a 29k-isolate
# snapshot, run it on a handful of strains whose ERG11 azole-resistance genotype is
# already published, and confirm the caller emits the expected panel token. This is the
# cheap de-risking slice named in TODOS.md (OPEN step 1) -- a fixed, citable truth set,
# NOT NCBI's (absent) labels.
# Run accessions are the SRA runs Lockhart et al. 2017 deposited under BioProject
# PRJNA328792 (resolved from NCBI SRA runinfo, 2026-08-15). The B-strains are canonical
# clade reference isolates; B11220 (clade II, azole-susceptible) is the WILD-TYPE control
# that must yield NO panel hit -- an independent strain through the exact Illumina path,
# so a spurious panel hit there means the orchestration (alignment/consensus), not the
# science, is wrong.
# PLATFORM: every run below is ILLUMINA paired WGS (verified via ENA, 2026-08-18). This is
# deliberate and load-bearing: reads_to_consensus aligns with `minimap2 -ax sr` (the
# short-read preset), which is also the path the real `fill` uses on NCBI snapshots (they
# are overwhelmingly Illumina). A PACBIO/NANOPORE run would misalign under `-ax sr` and
# call an honest but useless "uncalled", so the sanity set must not use one.
#   Excluded for this reason: the reference strain B8441's own run, SRR3883469, is PacBio
#   RS II (it is the reference-genome strain; no Illumina WGS run exists for it in this
#   BioProject -- its other Illumina data is RNA-Seq/amplicon). Its would-be role (the
#   reference's own reads must call wild-type) was the tightest control, but it cannot run
#   through the Illumina-only orchestration; B11220 covers the wild-type case instead. If a
#   long-read preset (`map-pb`/`map-ont`) is ever added, restore B8441 as a second WT row.
# expected_panel semantics: the panel (hotspot) substitution(s) the literature attributes
# to this strain's clade -- what result['panel_hits'] must CONTAIN. Empty ("-") means the
# strain is azole-susceptible / clade-Ia reference and must yield NO panel hit. Non-panel
# clade-defining polymorphisms will also be emitted by the caller and are expected/allowed
# (the caller tags only the panel; emergence.py judges the rest). The expected value is a
# literature-derived HYPOTHESIS the run confirms -- a mismatch means look at both the
# caller and the expectation (e.g. the F126L/F126T nomenclature note below).
# Columns (tab-separated): strain  clade  run_acc  expected_panel  note  citation
